superPowers.name: Odinsdottir‘s Might
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Angelic Assassin
superPowers.body: If this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character with an attack during its Activation, after this attack is resolved, this character may use this superpower. This character immediately Advances |!range_small|, then makes a |*Xiphos, the Sword of the Stars| attack. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Living Ribbons
superPowers.body: While an enemy character is Advancing or Climbing, it cannot Place the Movement Tool overlapping this character's base. Enemy characters cannot reroll or modify attack dice when targeting this character with attacks.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and 7 to 8 on Injured side.
Power cost for Blades of Ichor decreased from 1 to 0. Pursuit special rule does not need the |!hit| trigger anymore.
Heven's Wrath's Strength increased from 4 to 5 and power cost increased from 3 to 4.
Heven's Wrath's relies on the defender's |!threat| instead of the defender's |!size|.

Heven's Wrath's Cleave special rule reworked: now triggers on |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| instead of |!critical| |!critical| |!wild|, and simply grants an attack with a |!power| cost of 0, instead of restricting the additional attack to a second Heven's Wrath attack targeting the original target without the Cleave rule.
The timing for using Angelic Assassin was changed to "After this attack is resolved" instead of "When this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character with an attack"

The original text for Living Ribbons was "Enemy characters cannot place the movement tool overlapping this character's base. Enemy characters cannot reroll or change attack dice when targeting this character with attacks."
"After the attack is resolved" timing indication was added to Angelic Assassin superpower.
